## Metadata that Typst cannot use

![A figure that takes the built-in defaults.](plot.png){#fig-meta .wrap-right}

The metadata width `120%` leaves no room for text, and the metadata gap `1ex` has no Typst length, so the figure takes the built-in defaults, 40% and `1em`, and the render prints a warning for each. See @fig-meta. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua.

## A width of 100% or more

![A figure as wide as the text.](plot.png){#fig-full .wrap-left width="100%"}

The width leaves no room for text, so the figure takes the default width and the render prints a warning. See @fig-full. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua.

## An uncaptioned image with a height

![](plot.png){.wrap-right width="25%" height="2in" fig-alt="A small scatter plot"}
